title: knautia macedonica f. lyrophylla
intro: Knautia macedonica f. lyrophylla, commonly known as Macedonian Shepherd's Beak, is a flowering plant in the family Caprifoliaceae. It is used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Knautia macedonica f. lyrophylla include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
